unlocks.about: The unlock ladder (Bruno 2026-10-15, decisions set unlocks: the beta build). starters: playable from the start. rungs: the fighters earned, a rung each game clear, each rung its own size (Bruno 2026-10-15, the beta: Haggar, then Hanzo (SS2) + Haohmaru, then Kim as the final unlock; the older form ladder + rung_size cuts one list into equal rungs): each game clear (the last stage's boss beaten, boss_order) unlocks the next rung, kept forever in the save (MVS backup RAM / AES memory card: main.c save_t rungs). No other unlock (the roster's boss_of_stage locks are ignored while this block is here). Only these fighters stand on the select screen (select_layout: a place each, taken in ladder order); every other roster fighter is an enemy only. The select screen draws ONLY the unlocked ones (Bruno 2026-10-15: no silhouettes there): n unlocked = the first n of the ladder order, placed for that count by select.auto (spread along the street, no overlap; without it n consecutive places of select_layout, centred; build_tables.select_layers, one cursor graph per count). The ladder screen (main.c 'the unlock ladder') shows them all at full size on ONE line (Bruno 2026-10-15, the select screen's idea: 'make them spaced enough, from left to right; if the characters are too far to the right, just scroll'; screen: feet = their feet's y, pitch = px feet to feet in ladder order, margin = the first's feet from the TV's left edge, a row that fits the TV centred; build_tables.ladder_places), locked ones as dark silhouettes; a row wider than the TV: the camera pans to the rung just unlocked (main.c lad_camera): ONLY after a game clear that unlocked a rung (NEW CHALLENGERS!, the new rung revealed; no title entry, Bruno 2026-10-15). The save is cleared on the title with A+B+C+D held 2 s. Edited in the Factory (Characters: Roster & select, the ladder). Removing the block: every selectable fighter from the start again (and the bosses' own locks), the select layout to be re-placed.

auto.about: the select screen's places laid out by the build for every unlocked count (note 20261015-135645-e03d: 'Characters are bunched up together... avoid overlap as much as possible'; build_tables.select_auto / select_cams): one line along the street in ladder order, facing the middle, feet y alternating `feet` (front / back), each fighter as close to the previous as its drawn pose allows with `gap` px between their pixels, never closer than an even pitch filling the TV minus `margin` each side (at most `pitch` px feet to feet), centred on the street; a group wider than the screen: the camera pans along it (never past its ends). The hand layout (select_layout, the Factory's Select screen editor) gives the poses; remove this block to place them by hand again (its consecutive places, centred).

meter.about: the two bars (Bruno's live redesign 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md; fighter.c 'the meter'), players only (enemies pay nothing). DRIVE (shown: the HUD's two chunks): chunks x chunk points, full at the start and at a new life, one point back a frame (a chunk refills in chunk frames: 240 = 4 s); refill_pause: where the refill stops (Bruno 2026-10-09, note 20261009-115529-5d29: 'only outside of combos and activities'): 'special' = in a special (a C special, a Blitz, the breaker, a fury, a MAX), 'chain' = attacking (a chain's links, air attacks); back in neutral (idle, walk, run, jump) it refills; a C special costs `special` chunks (short of them it does not come out), a breaker (C or A+B in a hit stun or held: always the fighter's neutral C special) costs `breaker` chunks and blinks WHITE (blink frames white, as many not) for the whole move; short of them it costs life_breaker life (never the last point) and blinks RED instead. FURY GAUGE (hidden, never drawn): fury_max points, filled fury_dealt a point of damage dealt and fury_taken a point taken (the fury's own hits not counted), empty at the start, kept at a new life, emptied by the fury; full: D = the fury, full and life <= low % of the full life: D = the MAX; while full the fighter blinks 1 frame its colours / 1 frame a shiny white palette (red 1 / 1 when the MAX is ready); the life bar blinks red at low life (KOF95's 8 / 8, main.c). infinite 1: nothing spent, both full (a test switch)

special_flash.about: Bruno 2026-10-10 (note 20261010-145455-b3f3: 'every special that is triggered should make the character blink with a blue palette for a split second ... it's costing energy'): a C special paid with drive (C + the stick, the hold's C, a cancel into one, an air special on C) shows the fighter in a tinted palette for `frames` frames from its start; tint = the colour, 0-31 a channel (each channel = the colour's light x tint / 16 + tint / 4, clamped: fighter.c ovl_pal). Bruno 2026-10-10 reopen: '10 frames, completely fully blue' -> 10 frames, pure blue (no red / green left). Not the breaker (its white / red blink), not the fury / MAX (their own signals), not a free Blitz

blitz.about: the Blitz (Bruno 2026-10-08, docs/brawler_gold.md): a free, meterless move on a double direction + A: forward,forward / down,down / down,up / up,up + A (roster[].blitz ff / dd / du / uu: a special of its pool played free, not invincible, its own recovery; 'dash' = its dash attack, its tree's dash entry; absent = nothing; every fighter without a blitz entry: ff = 'dash'). window: frames allowed between the two taps and from the second tap to A (main.c read_player); run + A plays the ff slot too. chord: A+B = C, pressed on the same frame, or the second within `chord` frames of the first (fighter.c turns a prejump / a normal's first frames into the C). damage: a special played as a Blitz deals this whole damage on a full connect (its special tier scaled by damage / tiers.special)

jump.about: ONE jump for every fighter (Bruno 2026-10-08): Cody's Final Fight arc, captured frame by frame from the ROM in /data/emu (FBNeo, World 900112: /data/tmp/newsys/scripts/ff_jump.py): crouch frames on the ground, then one height (lines above the floor) a frame in the air, dx the forward jump's travel a frame in CPS1 pixels (scaled by x_scale 320 / 384 to the Neo Geo's pixels: the same distance on a TV), land_dx on the landing frame; a straight jump has no travel, a back jump the forward's mirrored. land: the landing's frames, any input ends it from land_cancel on (FF: cancellable at once). Air attacks: forward jump + A (roster[].air.forward), straight jump + A (air.straight) knock down and stay active active_min frames at least; down + A in either jump (air.down) flinches and stays active to the landing; down + A cancels into the jump's attack on hit (down_cancel 'hit'; 'any': at any time). Defaults (a fighter without roster[].air): forward atk_d_jump, straight atk_c_jump, down atk_a_jump

walk.about: walk speeds by archetype (Bruno 2026-10-08: Terry = Cody, Kim = Guy, Krauser = Haggar): Final Fight's 2.10 / 1.95 / 1.85 CPS1 px a frame x 320 / 384 = the same time to cross the screen; sub-pixel (16.16, no whole-pixel rounding); run = run x walk; the walk / run animations play at the new speed / the fighter's KOF speed (feet don't slide); anim = the walk / run animations' frame rate x this on top (Bruno 2026-10-08: 1.5, the frames switch faster, the movement speed unchanged); run_anim = the RUN animation's factor instead of anim (note 20261014-141702-5d29, 'the run animation is playing too fast': with anim's 1.5 the run's steps went by at the source's pace while the body covers ~2/3 of the source's run distance; 1 = the feet keep their source stride; a roster walk_rate fighter keeps its fixed rate: build_tables.run_anim)

depth.about: the walkable floor's back edge per background (stage.h stages[] index, tools/brawler/make_stage_ra.py): [x, z] points along the stage (world px, x rising; z = the smallest Z a fighter may have there, feet y = floor_top + z), straight lines between them, the end points' Z past them; a background without an entry: Z from 0. Players and enemies: walking, spawning, knockback, the AI's goals (fighter.c clamp, ai.c slot_goal). Read on the art: the lowest scenery pixel (wall curb, truck shadow, rubble) + 2 px. Bruno 2026-10-09 (note 20261009-102742-5d29, stage 1 wave 2, x 919): z 15 is the deepest there, else the feet step over the background pixels. Background 1 (stage 1): rubble 0-80, the wall's curb (y 163) z 8, the wall's slope + the truck's shadow (171) z 15, the scrap pile (168) z 12 with its two striped bars lying out (176 / 172) z 20 / 16, the second truck z 15, the crate and the barrier (163) z 8

tiers.about: the damage tiers (revamp phase 2, Bruno 2026-10-08: specials about equal across all characters +-15 %, furies +-20 %, MAX +-20 %, special < fury < MAX; fighter.c 'damage tiers'): the whole damage of every special / fury / MAX on a full connect (life 60; the chain totals 21 / 23 / 27: a special about half a chain, a fury one heavy chain and more, the MAX two chains); spread = the allowed band in %, the bands may not overlap; measured = each move's own total in our emulator (tools/brawler/damage_tiers.py --raw --save), each move scaled to its tier; super_throw = the super throw's whole damage (revamp 3: between the special and the fury, a stock buys it)

chain.about: the chain core (revamp 1A, docs/brawler_feel.md 8h, fighter.c 'chain core', routes.py chain_tree): one system for every fighter. A chain advances only on a hit; a whiff or being hit restarts it at link 1. window: frames after a link's recovery to press the next one; buffer: a player's press this many frames (hit-stop not counted) before the next link may start still fires, a press in the hit-stop is latched; lengths: links by roster[].archetype (Final Fight's Guy 5 / Cody 4 / Haggar 3); totals: the whole chain's damage by archetype (Final Fight 42 / 46 / 54, halved to the brawler's life of 60); hitstop: [jab, finisher] frames, link k on that scale, every finisher the last (a special's / fury's / throw's: the engine's 7); juggle_cap: air hits a juggled fighter takes, then untouchable until it lands (downed: untouchable; a fury's own hits excepted); stun_player + guard_player: a player's hit stun and its untouchable window from the hit (only the one that hit it reaches it meanwhile); stun_light / stun_heavy: an enemy's hit stun. roster[].finishers: launcher = the stick that plays the launcher (up, forward or neutral), down = sweep (a trip) or slam (a ground slam that bounces), or null; neutral / forward / up / down_move = a move name to override the generator's pick

throw_body.about: the thrown body (Bruno's note 20261014-132326-5d29: 'the impact of the opponents thrown on the floor should also resonate to other enemies, like in Final Fight'; gamedata.h gtbody_t, fighter.c combat 'THROWN BODIES', build_tables tbody_tables): ONE rule for every throw of every fighter: a paired throw's victim from its release row to its landing row, a throw special's victim while it falls, then `floor` frames on the floor (its impact), knocks down every other enemy it touches (each once, the throw's way): `damage`, `hitstop` the hit one's freeze, `body_hitstop` the body's own (with its thrower while it still holds it), `depth` px of depth reached, `sound` the hit's songs.json sfx code, `players` false = a player is never hit by a thrown body (Final Fight). Final Fight measured in FBNeo (/data/tmp/body5d29, Cody / Guy forward throws, a pinned bystander): 8 damage + knockdown, 6 frames of hit-stop on the bystander AND the body, the whole flight and the landing's first frames hit (the slide after does not), depth +-9; the knee finisher's and the chain finisher's knockdowns hit nobody (no body: hold hits never make one). Per throw: roster[].throws.body {"throw_c" | "throw_d" | "throw_x" | "special": {fields} | false}. Before the note: 6 damage, hit-stop 7, the flight only (the landing row excluded), 12 px

throw_swap.about: throws part 1 (docs/throws_audit.md 'After', 2026-10-12; gamedata.h gthrow_t, fighter.c throw_start): when a throw's row 0 puts its victim somewhere else than where the hold had it (a throw played turned by the direction rule, an SS2 / DD grab drawn turned, the chain's back throw taking a reeling victim where it stands), the victim travels there over the throw's first `frames` rows instead of jumping in one frame, lifted `arc` px at the middle of the way (it passes over the thrower); `glide_px`: the pair's own move at the start (the held part of the script kept inside the screen, fighter.c pair_fit) glides at most that many px a row (over more rows than `frames` when it is longer; note 20261014-134238-5d29: a thrower slid 231 px in 4 frames). The flight from the release row on is not fitted: the thrown body stops at the screen's edge alone, KOF98's rule (fighter.c thrown_edge). throw_handoff (top level, Bruno's decision card): 'release' = the victim is the engine's knocked-down body from the throw's release row (the 2026-10-08 rule), 'landing' = the script plays its flight to its landing row, then the brawler's fall / knockdown (the release row only starts the thrown body that hits others)

hit_sounds.about: the hit sounds (Bruno's impact-sound picks 2026-10-09, brawler-lab/impacts.html; gamedata.h ghitsnd_t, fighter.c btn_sound): songs.json sfx names. light / strong: the hit cycles, every A / B normal's hit (a hold's, a throw's sounding as A / B) plays the attacker's next light entry, every C / D one its next strong entry (C+D and knockdowns: $15; a fighter's roster[].hit_sfx button or a route node's own sound list still wins). light = KOF94's cycle of three, table $59FA (indices $E1 $E4 $E7, pan C $1A $60 / $63 / $66), counter $46F8(a5) + 1 mod 3 on every normal hit ($594C); strong = KOF95's cycle of eight, table $5674 = indices $0C $0D $0F $0F $0D $0D $0E $0F = one-byte commands $C0 $C1 $C3 $C3 $C1 $C1 $C2 $C3, counter $5E66(a5) & 7 ($5542; KOF95 has no strong set, Bruno: 'KOF95 hit by strong (cyclic)'). Both games keep one counter for the whole game; here each attacker its own (fighter_t.hcyc). guard: the guard sound (KOF94's projectile hit; no guard yet: fighter_guard_sound, unused); boss_ko: the boss's killing hit (KOF94's KO blow), its death voice scream_delay frames later (main.c boss_ko_start / boss_ko_tick, < 300: inside the slow motion); hurt_voice: when a hit body plays its hurt voice (its VK_HIT; gamedata.h HV_*): "hit" every hit, "launch" sent off the floor by a hit (into its knockdown from any other state), "land" its first floor contact after a launch or a throw (a throw: its first impact); note 20261014-170634-5d29 (Bruno: only launch and landing, players and enemies alike); the impact sounds play on every hit whatever this says, the KO voice at the death as before; bounce: each floor contact of the boss's death fall, its first landing and the one after its bounce (KOF94's KO landing, index $227: $66EA plays it in place of the body landing when the fallen body has no life, on both contacts $8C7C / $8D00; feedback 20261009-223719-b3f3; main.c boss_ko_start sets fighter_t.kthud, fighter.c floor_thud); rest_music: the stage clear's music this many frames after the KO'd boss came to rest on the floor (its final landing after every bounce), the one and only trigger of that music (main.c boss_ko_tick, note 20261014-172113-5d29: 'has the boss really fallen completely on the floor, then start the music'); >= the bounce sample's length (94 KO LANDING: 25856 ADPCM-A bytes = 2.79 s = 168 frames, build_tables checks it against build/snd/snd_report.json)

super_flash.about: fx.super_flash (TODO #139, Bruno 2026-10-06: an engine rule, no per-move data but an optional anchor): every fury (D) and MAX fury (down+D) of every fighter. From the fury's frame start the game freezes except the attacker for freeze frames (enemies, projectiles, the camera, waves and timers, other players; only the attacker's own boxes hit: Kim's Phoenix hits inside the flash, KOF's furies 39-47 frames in, after it), the stage is hidden and the backdrop is white_colour for white frames, then dark_colour; KOF98's concentration plays at the anchor (the move's own, read from its KOF animation, else this one: px from the feet, KOF orientation, negative x = forward), blue for a fury, orange for a MAX fury. Values: KOF98's (tools/kof96/handlers98.md 'Super flash': the flash effect's animation + 1 = 28 frames, its white event step + 1 = 4). sound (Bruno 2026-10-06, the fury charge): the effect played at the flash start, KOF98's own: the flash routine $370F0 / $373FC sends sound index $99 = $1A $3A for every DM and SDM alike (measured in our emulator: Terry, Ryo, Ralf, Kyo, DM and MAX, the same command on the flash frame); must be in songs.json sfx. sound_max (TODO #155, Bruno 2026-10-06: KOF2000's MAX sound, the high whistle): played instead of sound when the fury is the MAX (down+D): KOF2000's SDM flash effect, $1E $8F there (measured in our emulator: K' and Terry, every DM flash $1E $BC, every SDM flash $1E $8F), the brawler $1A $8F (songs.json sfx from). A fury that WAITS (roster[].fury_flash: wait / move; default wait for a sequence fury, roster[].fury = a list; Bruno results-1014, Haggar: make him wait during the freeze): its first piece's first frame is held through the whole freeze, the piece plays from the first frame after it (fighter.c flash_pose); invincible from the trigger as every fury

rules.about: Every enemy's shared rules (revamp 1B, docs/brawler_data_model.md 'Enemy rules', ai.c): attack tokens, the ready pose during the random wait, wind-up by damage, the hidden difficulty rank.

guard.about: The guard's engine rules (T9, Bruno 2026-10-15: bosses can block; fighter.c 'guard', any fighter the AI makes guard: a boss's enemies[].boss_ai.guard). A hit from the front on a guarding fighter is blocked: a normal deals nothing, a special / Blitz / projectile chip = its damage x chip / 256 (never the last point); the guard stun: stun frames in the guard pose, sliding back push px a frame (decaying); the guard sound hit_sounds.guard and the guard spark. Beaten by: a hit from behind, a fury or a MAX (unblockable), a grab or a command grab, and the guard's own limit (boss_ai.guard.max hits, the next one breaks it).

boss_ai.about: T9 (Bruno 2026-10-15, ai.c 'the boss layer'): guard {chance of 256 per attack of his target starting within dx / dz, hold frames at least, max hits blocked before it breaks, rest frames before the next}; run {chance of 256 an approach from farther than `from` px runs in, to `stop` px}; grab {immune / counter: of 256, rolled each time his target comes near: a grab on him does not take / is reversed into his own throw after delay frames}; red {low % of his life: the red period (he blinks red), his fury every rest frames within dx, the first max of them the MAX}; ready_shift (his ready wait >> it); combos: his strings, each attack plays one not used yet this fight (A / C / D after an optional stick f b u d df uf, run / jump first, grab last; a D only in the red period)

stage_intro.about: Every campaign stage's start (voice note 20261014-192343-5d29; main.c 'the stage intro'): black, the background fades in (palette fade over `fade` ticks, nobody on screen, no HUD), `title` on the fix layer from `title_at` for `title_hold` ticks ({name} = the stage's name), at `walk_at` the players walk in (`gait` walk | run, their own speed, input locked) from `from` px outside the `side` edge to their `marks` ([x px from that edge, z] P1, P2), the HUD back, then control and `wave_delay` ticks later the first wave. Ticks from the stage's start (60 a second). A stage's own `intro` (same fields) overrides these. A new game, stage 2+, after a bonus game, a new game from CONTINUE on the title: all play it; the attract demo and the Lab's starts do not. Edited in the Factory's Levels tab (levels.py intro).
stage_intro.title: {name} START

big_text.about: The BIG font for the screens' headlines (Bruno 2026-10-14: 'I like the one from SAVAGE REIGN'): Savage Reign's round-call letters (R O U N D 1-4: 16 x 48 px, its palette) completed to A-Z, 0-9, ! . - ' : ? in their construction (tools/brawler/make_bigfont.py). A use listed here draws that screen's headline in the big font (sprites, a 48 px row), the small fix-layer text staying for the detail lines; a use left out keeps its fix-layer line. Uses: stage_intro (stage_intro.title), stage_clear, game_over, time_over (the bonus game's clock out), bonus_won (the bonus's won_text[0]). Fields: y = the glyphs' top on screen (px, the cell is 48 high, 0-176) (note 20261014-231446-5d29: 36 = right under the top HUD, which ends at y 32, so the fighters stay in view; the bonus results' detail lines follow y: the line under the headline, BONUS 2 rows lower; bonus_won's CONGRATULATIONS / BONUS on the 2 rows over it, its lines under the second line), slide = ticks sliding in from the right (0 = in place), blink = half-period in ticks (0 = steady), pitch = px between the two lines of a text wider than 304 px (it breaks at a double space; default 44), text = the line (stage_clear / game_over / time_over only; defaults STAGE CLEAR / GAME OVER / TIME OVER). Centred; one message at a time (main.c 'big text': up to 24 sprites, 324-347, counted by the line guard).

boss_order.about: The campaign's bosses in play order (Bruno 2026-10-15, beta: 4 stages, stage 2 the garage off): the n-th stage in play (stages[] without "off": true) fights the boss of the stage boss block whose enemy is bosses[n] (enemy, song, minions, drama, seed, z from that block, whichever stage holds it; lock and x from the stage's own boss block: its length). One boss per stage in play; the last one's stage clear = the game clear (unlocks).

bonus.about: The bonus stages (TODO T7, Bruno 2026-10-14, decision sets bonus-game + bonus-followup; analysis /data/neogeo_dict/aof/bonus.md): after each stage listed in `after` (1-based) a pick screen offers every game of `games` (AOF2's SELECT BONUS GAME: stick + A, `pick.seconds` on the clock, the cursor's game at 0). A game is a level type the engine reads (main.c 'bonus stages', build_tables.py bonus_tables): scene = an AOF2 scene of tools/brawler/make_bonus.py (tree, posts); kind gauge = one press on a sweeping gauge (power 0-127, + step a frame, wrapping; grade k = the power reached grades[k - 1], AOF2 Spirit Training's table $17EF8 at its default row: 36 68 92 108 120), reward chunks[grade] = drive chunks added to both players' bars for the credit (up to 4); win_grade = the lowest grade that passes (AOF2: only the top, 5; note 20261014-133606-5d29): a pass breaks the tree (AOF2's fall, make_bonus.py fall_seq) and plays win_music (AOF2's $2D), a lower grade fails (the tree stands, TRAINING FAILED, over_music $2E); blows = the blow per grade 0-5 (Bruno results-1014: a jab when the tree holds, the forward finisher when it breaks): jab = his chain's first link (neutral A), finisher = its neutral finisher, forward = its forward finisher (fighter.c fighter_blow; the tree's reaction and timing stay AOF2's); kind break = break `count` objects before `seconds` run out, one at a time, with the move class `breaks_with` (any: every regular strike, `hp` hits an object, the fury staying locked while it plays, note bonus-pillars-normals; fury: only the fury's or the MAX's body or its objects, any other hit only shakes it), `lesson` = the lesson box's 3 lines, all broken = reward unlock (fury: Fury and Fury MAX on D; the first win shows `won_text`'s 3 lines for `won_ticks`). fury_lock true: D's fury and MAX locked from a new game until a game with unlock fury is won; a fail keeps it locked for the credit (a continue keeps it); the attract demo and the Lab are never locked. Before the pick and the game, AOF2's own screens (notes 20261014-085447-5d29 / -085507-5d29, Bruno 2026-10-14: AOF2's original select screen; tools/brawler/make_bonus.py screens, tools/aof/bonus_rip.py): `intro` = AOF2's BONUS GAME screen (`music` + the announcer `voice`, a songs.json sfx name, at tick `at`; `ticks` long); the pick screen is AOF2's SELECT BONUS GAME (its three pictures; a game takes AOF2's slot `slot`: 0 Spirit Training, 2 Super Death Blow; a slot without a game, 1 Strength Training here, is greyed and the cursor skips it; `pick.seconds` 3-9 on its clock); then the game's title card (its slot's kanji and name, `card.ticks` long, the game's `voice` + `card.sound`). A game already won shows its bonus only (the game has no score).

games.name: KI TRAINING
games.grades_about: note 20261015-144120-e03d (tester: 'too hard; if you are in the top quarter, you succeed'): the top grade (PERFECT, the pass) from 96 = the gauge's top quarter (0-127); the lower grades spread under it (was AOF2's 36 68 92 108 120)

charge.about: AOF2 measured (note 20261014-133606-5d29, tools/aof/ki_fail.py): Ryo stands 7 frames after the press, holds his concentration, punches; his punch lands 99 frames after the press on a failed grade, 159 on the pass: our blow starts 11 ticks before it lands

games.bonus_about: note 20261015-221208-e03d (tester: 'too many messages'): no name / lesson at the start (just go, the HUD's TIME and POSTS only), posts of 12 hits (were 3 of 4), the win told by SS2's referee (won_by referee: won_text = his speech; the fighter blinks when his fury gauge is full). Round 2 (Bruno: 'let's go with four, easier'): 4 posts (were 5); damage_at = the hits taken at which AOF2's own cracked pictures of the post show (make_bonus.py post 1-3: AOF2's frames 558 / 840 / 1116, the crack growing across the trunk)

referee.about: SS2's referee delivers a message (note 20261015-221208-e03d; main.c 'the referee', gamedata.h gref_t): Samurai Shodown II's Kuroko as SS2 brings him to the front after certain one-player matches (KURO-SYS state 12, decoded in tools/samsho2/referee_ss2.py, study /data/neogeo_dict/samsho2/README.md 'The referee's speech'): sidesteps on the back lane (24 px behind the floor, 1 px a frame, SS2's sidestep animations), one frame standing, the jump (Kuroko's own jump: vy -2432 / 256, gravity 96 / 256, behind the fighters rising, in front falling), the landing 8 px nearer the camera with his shadow, then SS2's message window opening and his lines typed a letter every 2 frames (SS2's pace), held `hold` ticks after the last letter (a button ends it from then), the window closing. He enters from the screen edge farther from the player, `from` px outside it, and jumps at `mark` px from it. Used by a bonus game with won_by referee (its won_text = his 1-3 lines, 18 characters each: centred inside the window with 6 px to its border, note 20261016-045652-e03d)
referee.hit_about: note 20261015-221208-e03d round 2 (Bruno: 'after the referee's message is shown, if the player presses D, the fury gets triggered into the referee and the referee gets hit; after that the referee wakes up and says HORRIBLE ATMOSPHERE'): while his message is held, D (the only thing the player can do then) closes the window, the fighter runs at him to fury_dx px and fires his fury (gauge filled); its first strike touching the referee knocks him down: Kuroko's own SS2 reactions (his table 17: the flight 220, landing / lying 222, the get-up 138), flying away at knock_vx px a tick, knock_vy (8.8) up, his jump's gravity; lying down_ticks; up, his window opens again with hit_text (SS2's own line: $206FDC message 0, on two lines: 18 letters a line inside the window, note 20261016-045652-e03d), held hold ticks, closed. Without D the speech ends as before

geese_intro.speaker: GEESE
lines: So you made it this far.

ending.about: The ending (Bruno 2026-10-11, decisions open-2026-10-11 card ending-music): after the last stage's boss and the win poses, main.c's ending screens in this order: story (the winner's big portrait, else his win pose + HUD face, his story typed in a box that scrolls; music = music), staff (the credits scrolling up a pixel at a time, a line (8 px) every `step` ticks: sprites drawn by tools/brawler/staff_roll.py in the S ROM font; music = staff_music), thanks (the winner in his win pose; the staff song fades out, $0A + fade), then BOSS UNLOCKED when the boss was beaten for the first time, then back to the BIOS (title / attract). Each screen: START (or A-D) goes on after `min` ticks; story: `type` ticks a character, `hold` ticks once typed; staff: `hold` ticks once the last line is up; thanks: `time` ticks. story.fighters: per roster fighter (by name) 4-5 sentences, '*' = any other; build_tables.py wraps them to 34 columns. staff.lines: a string a line, '^' = a heading (highlighted), centred, at most 34 characters.

story.type_about: ticks per character typed (note 20261015-144529-e03d, tester: 'slow down the hero's text, two times slower': 2 -> 4)

*: The last enemy falls, and the city goes quiet.
The winner stands alone under the morning sun.
The bosses of the underworld are gone.
Word of this fight spreads far and wide.
A new legend has been born.
terry: Rugal falls, and the wind over the city goes still.
Terry tips his cap and walks away without a word.
Rock is waiting for him back in South Town.
The Lone Wolf has a promise to keep.
Okay! It is time to go home.
ryo: The last of the bosses lies at Ryo's feet.
He bows, as his father Takuma taught him.
At the Kyokugen dojo, the students cheer the news.
Robert pays for the party, as always.
At dawn, the Invincible Dragon is back in training.
ralf: Ralf radios Commander Heidern with the good news.
Clark already has the helicopter warmed up.
The Ikari Warriors leave before the police arrive.
New orders are waiting for them in the desert.
robert: Robert Garcia smiles for the cameras.
His father's company will rebuild every street that burned.
Yuri calls to say that Ryo is jealous.
Robert laughs and books the best table in town.
The Raging Tiger always wins in style.
yamazaki: Ryuji Yamazaki counts the money he took from the bosses.
South Town's underworld has a new king.
Nobody dares to look him in the eye.
But the Orochi blood in his veins will not keep quiet.
He laughs, and the night laughs with him.
billy: Billy Kane looks up at the empty Geese Tower.
For the first time in years, he answers to no one.
He sends a postcard to his sister Lilly in England.
Then he spins his staff and walks into the rain.
South Town will hear from him again.
kyo: The fight is over, and Kyo Kusanagi yawns.
He has missed another exam at school.
Yuki is waiting at the gate with her arms crossed.
Somewhere in the dark, Iori is already hunting him.
iori: Iori Yagami stands alone among the ruins.
The moon is red, and his blood is howling.
He does not spare a glance for the fallen.
Only one name is on his mind: Kyo Kusanagi.
mai: Mai Shiranui bows with her fan held high.
The Shiranui ninja arts have proven themselves again.
Now she wants her reward: a wedding with Andy.
But Andy has already left to train in the mountains.
Mai runs after him, shouting his name.
yashiro: Yashiro Nanakase cracks his neck and laughs.
Nobody in this city was strong enough to stop him.
Tonight his band plays to a packed house.
But deep below, Orochi stirs in its sleep.
One of the Heavenly Kings is awake.
geese: Geese Howard looks down from the top of his tower.
Every rival who dared to challenge him is broken.
South Town belongs to him once more.
He pours a glass of wine and smiles at the night.
mr_big: Mr. Big counts the money from his new clubs.
Every gang in the city now pays him tribute.
His sticks spin faster than ever.
Only Takuma and his Kyokugen fools still stand.
Next time, he swears, they will fall too.
krauser: Wolfgang Krauser returns to his castle in Germany.
To him, this fight was a fine game and nothing more.
His orchestra plays a requiem in his honour.
He has not forgotten his half-brother Geese.
The Emperor awaits a worthy rival.
k_dash: K' pulls his glove tight and turns his back.
NESTS made him a weapon, but he fights for himself.
Maxima is waiting with the engine running.
K' says nothing on the long drive.
rugal: Rugal Bernstein laughs on the deck of his carrier.
Another army of fighters has fallen before him.
Their statues will join his gallery tonight.
The power of Orochi still burns in his eye.
The King of Fighters is Rugal alone.
haohmaru: Haohmaru drinks sake under the cherry blossoms.
His sword rests at his side, its work done.
Genjuro is still out there, and their duel waits.
There is always a stronger opponent somewhere.
At dawn, he takes the road again.
genjuro: Genjuro Kibagami wipes his blade clean.
He fought for no one but himself.
The gambling dens will talk of nothing else.
But Haohmaru still lives, and that will not do.
Genjuro walks into the night, a card in his hand.
cheng_fu: Cheng Fu bows to his fallen opponents.
His kung fu was tested in the streets and held.
He returns to his small school in the old town.
His students listen to the tale with wide eyes.
hanzo: Hattori Hanzo vanishes in a puff of smoke.
The honour of the Iga clan is restored.
Fuuma will say he could have done it faster.
Hanzo does not bother to answer him.
The time machine carries him back to his era.
hanzo_ss2: Hattori Hanzo sheathes his blade in silence.
The shogun will hear of this victory tonight.
At home, his son Shinzo waits for him.
The Iga ninja serve from the shadows.
Hanzo is gone before the dust settles.
kim: Kim Sue Il lowers his leg and bows.
His taekwondo has broken every gang in the city.
Justice, he says, must always win.
He promises to keep watch over these streets.
billy_lee: Billy Lee wipes the blood from his lip.
The gang that ruled the city is broken.
Jimmy shows up late, as always.
The Lee brothers ride home together.
The Sosetsuken has kept the city safe again.

benched.about: The beta build (Bruno 2026-10-15): what is kept in game.json but not built. Goenitz is out (his roster entry is in roster_benched, Lab-only); here his enemy definition, his big portrait, his stage intro drama and his ending story (and his AI ready pose: ai.rules.ready.by_fighter "goenitz": ["atk_c_close", 1]); select_layout_full = the full roster's select places before the beta (0.10.106, Goenitz's taken out): put it back as select_layout when the unlocks block goes. To bring him back: his roster entry back into roster (+ a select_layout place, + a place in unlocks), these back into enemies / portraits / dramas / ending.story.fighters, BOSS_GOENITZ back from songs.json songs_benched, and GOENITZ into boss_order (STAGE 4's own boss block, the former stage 5's, still names him).

goenitz: The storm dies down, and Goenitz folds his hands.
The humans fought well, but no one stops the wind.
He returns to his quiet church to pray.
Orochi will awaken soon, as it was written.
Heaven's wind blows in his favour.
